svg.title: Harness NUD (dia)
svg.desc: NUD-styled harness architecture. Violet = structure; orange = live actors (Thinker, Manager, worker). Solid double-headed arrow = read + edit; dashed single-headed arrow (folder to actor) = read only; no arrow = no access.
